references.qualification: Primarily in the upper1000m does not quantify a transport fraction, imply zero below1000m, or establish whole-route thickness. The1500m level of no motion is a reconstruction assumption, not a measured current bottom. Between-front flow may reverse; two eastward jets must not be represented as one uniformly filled section. Six Cape Basin cases have uneven support, including limited V2 data below500m and an incompletely crossed northern front in1990. Argentine Basin SAVE5 comparisons and Brazil Current recirculation are not independent confirmation of a uniform route depth. No annual depth extrema inferred.

references.range_interpretation: Approximate occupied regional component depth band, not a range of current-bottom depths, confidence limits or annual extrema.

references.qualification: Water-mass component interval, not the whole current from surface to500m or an independently detected velocity boundary. The450–500m salinity minimum marks a property feature within the component and is not a second flow-thickness reference. Adjacent100–250m subtropical ENACW belongs to the source Azores Current component and must not be substituted. Do not inherit the Portugal coastal countercurrent/undercurrent or the559m sediment-site bathymetry. Modern setting is not dated to the paleoclimate record; no annual or seasonal range established.
